fusions.name: Thumb-Claw Latch
fusions.desc: Flings a clawed barb that deals 7 dark damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Roost Drop
fusions.desc: Drops you onto a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 13 damage and drags its guard open, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rafter Line
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. You gain +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Clinging Thirst
fusions.desc: Anything you strike moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. When you land a critical hit, your attacks heal you for 20% of their damage for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
